goal: Add the original fixture model to the existing provider.
initial_conditions: Isolated virtual workspace; without_docs; trusted project; fixed user and workspace roots; no generated-code execution.
observable_result: The original upstream structured-output fields must match exactly; this is a Go environment adaptation, not a Pi runtime execution.

steps.content: Configure this running Pi installation with a new `openai/fixture-chat` model. Do not create project-local configuration. Show it as “Fixture Chat”. It accepts text, supports reasoning, has a 32,768-token context window and a 4,096-token maximum output, and has no usage cost.

checks.name: upstream_contract
checks.basis: Strict equality of the structured observation in the pinned upstream judge; runtime differences are recorded in the baseline catalog.

The current working directory is /eval/workspace, HOME is /eval/home, and the agent directory is /eval/home/.pi/agent. The project is already trusted. Files under /eval/runtime are read-only. All file tools operate on isolated virtual files; no shell, network or generated code execution is available. Report errors honestly.
